title: FEA max bending stress uses c = sqrt(A)/2 (square-section assumption) inconsistent with section I, so stress and utilization are under-reported (unconservative)
repro_steps: Cantilever: node fa 0,0,0 Fixed; fb 78.74 in Free; default member A=8.25 in^2, I=82.8 in^4, A36 E=200 GPa; Fy=-2248.09 lb at fb; Run FEA
expected: sigma = M*c/I with the section's real extreme-fiber distance (e.g. W8-class depth ~8 in gives c ~4 in, sigma ~8,600 psi, ~40% utilization)
actual: Deflection 0.1524 in matches PL^3/3EI (0.1523 in). But max stress shows 3070.3 psi / 14.2% PASS. M = PL = 177,016 lb-in, so implied c = 3070.3*82.8/177016 = 1.436 in = sqrt(8.25)/2 exactly. That's a solid square's half-depth, while I=82.8 in^4 can't belong to a square of 8.25 in^2 (that square has I=5.67 in^4). Stress is likely under-reported about 2.8x for the real shape; the 'check passed' receipt can pass members that fail.
suspected_area: engineering FEA stress recovery (section c / section modulus)
fix_note: FEA bending stress used an area-only square-section assumption for the extreme-fiber distance. computeStresses now derives c from the section's own geometry (c = sqrt(3I/A) for the rectangular identity the inputs imply) and rows carry cIn + cBasis; the audit case moves from 3,070 psi / 14.2% to 11,731 psi / 54.3%, consistent with the reported moment of inertia — the SAP2000/ETABS behaviour of recovering stress from the section's real section modulus. Pin: server/tests/fea-stress-section-consistency.test.js.

title: ▶ Playtest mints a live public world that has no owner Settings/Delete in Sub-worlds My Worlds and is not removed by draft delete; world becomes uncleanable
fix_note: Founder ruling A (2026-11-13): playtest stays private. Premise at branch state: the worlds table has NO privacy column; the mint (POST /api/worlds from playtest-check's payload) wrote an unmarked active row, the B15 bridge rendered every table row privacy:'public' + enterable in Sub-Worlds Discover, the public GET /api/worlds listed every active row, bridged rows carried can_edit/is_owner false so no Settings/Delete reached them, and draft-delete never touched the row. Fix: playtest-check's payload carries playtest.draftId; POST /api/worlds stamps rule_modulators.playtest on the row (founded worlds unmarked, unchanged). Public legs cut at the read: GET /api/worlds filters marked rows; Sub-Worlds Discover skips marked rows (a public draft's copy still surfaces as the draft view — sharing stays publishing's job); Sub-Worlds visit refuses marked rows to non-owners ('world is private', the A3 shape); tableView labels a marked row 'private' in the owner's own lists. Disposal: world-creator draft-delete cascades to every marked row naming the draft (linked mint + unlinked orphans), owner-guarded, marked-rows only; sub_worlds archive (the Settings/Delete verb) now also resolves marked table rows for their owner. FE: DraftEditor no longer swallows the draft-publish link failure — it reports in words that the copy stays private and dies with the draft. Pins: server world-creator-playtest-privacy.test.js 6/6 on the fixed tree, 6/6 failing at pristine; seam-bridge + both parity suites + 69 neighbouring world tests green. NAMED: (1) direct entry by world id through the Concordia world runtime (loadWorld by id) is unchanged — every in-product surface that can REVEAL the id to a non-owner is cut, but link-proof entry gating is a platform slice for the desk if the founder wants it. (2) The My Worlds FE settings panel still opens only on store worlds (the B15 bridge's standing can_edit seam) — the archive verb reaches playtest rows server-side now; panel wiring for bridged rows is the bridge seam's own follow-up. (3) Re-playtesting a draft mints a fresh copy each time; earlier copies stay owner-only and die with the draft.

note: Related stills: evidence/reflection/case15-delete-click-reload.png, case28-delete-confirmed.png, case29-after-reload.png. Delete works on confirm; this ticket is the weak first-click cue only. Account zuko_qa_t1.
fix_note: The armed delete state in RfEntriesPanel was only a text-color change and the button's aria-label stayed 'Delete' in both states, so the armed state was invisible to sighted and screen-reader users alike. Armed state now has a rose fill + ring, visible 'Click again to confirm' text, and state-aware aria-labels on both the journal chips and entry rows.

title: Removing a person has no confirm
repro_steps: Org Chart: Remove on a person.
expected: A confirm or undo before removing.
actual: Removed immediately ('Removed (0 reports reassigned)').
fix_note: OrgDesigner's employee-remove fired the removal on a single click. It is now a two-step named confirm (confirmRemoveId state): the first click arms a 'Remove <name>?' confirm, the second executes; any other action disarms.

title: Dashboard panel removed without confirm; Add inserts fixed 'CPU %' panel (no name) [RCA-missing-delete-confirm]
repro_steps: Dashboard > Edit panels > + Add > trash
expected: Choose/name panel; confirm delete
actual: Default panel added; deleted on one click
fix_note: CustomDashboard's Add inserted a fixed CPU% panel regardless of intent and the trash icon deleted a panel instantly. Add now opens a kind/metric chooser so the user picks what to add, and panel removal is a two-step named confirm.

title: Health tab marked LIVE shows dashes for Status/RSS/DTUs, empty Sessions/Storage
repro_steps: System > Health
expected: Values or honest gated/empty message
actual: '—' values beside 'LIVE' label; uptime 2.4h only
fix_note: SystemHealthPanel's header chip said 'live' unconditionally, including when the health query had failed or never returned, and unreported fields rendered as bare dashes. The chip now reflects the real query state (live / connecting… / unreachable) and unreported fields carry an explanatory note instead of a bare dash.

title: Results tab shows 'sample results' statistics when no runs exist — could be mistaken for real data
fix_note: SimConsole's ResultsTab rendered fabricated fallback statistics, charts and risk figures — and offered a CSV export of them — when no run was selected. With no run selected it now renders an honest empty state with no numbers and no export.

title: Cite → DTU gives no link or record of created DTU
repro_steps: Web research 'Alan Turing' > Cite → DTU
expected: Toast/link to created DTU
actual: Button becomes 'Cited', nothing surfaced
fix_note: WebResearchTool captured the cited DTU's id on cite but only flipped its label to 'Cited', giving the user no path to the DTU they had just cited. The cited state now renders a 'Cited — view DTU' link to /lenses/dtu?id=<id>.

title: Saved circuits have no rename/edit
repro_steps: Save a circuit, reload.
expected: Rename/edit on saved circuits.
actual: Only Load and Delete. (Create, persist, delete PASS.)
fix_note: Circuits could be created and deleted but never renamed. New owner-scoped renameCircuit verb in server/domains/quantum.js (name-only update, non-empty, 120-char clean title limit) plus an inline rename control in ComposerPanel.

title: Notebook formulas have no edit control
repro_steps: Notebook: save a formula, reload.
expected: Edit option on saved formulas.
actual: Only view/delete; no edit.
fix_note: FormulaNotebookPanel was create/delete only. It now supports formula edit through useLensData's update with an inline form (name / latex / description / category).

title: Edit offers only a single caption/title field; no tags, alt text or separate caption
fix_note: Photos had nowhere to store alt text or tags. Migration 504_photo_alt_tags.js adds alt_text + tags to user_photos (guarded ALTERs, 468 pattern); updatePhoto accepts altText (<=300 chars) and tags (cleaned: lowercase, unique, <=40 chars, max 12, JSON-stored, parsed back to arrays; pre-504 databases degrade silently); listMyPhotos returns both; the REST route and photos.update macro pass them through. The editor gains Alt text + Tags fields, grid img alt prefers alt_text, and tags render as chips.

title: SPC samples and IoT readings have no delete; SPC card shows CPK 0.00 while note says Cpk reads 1.00 by construction
fix_note: Two legs. (1) SPC samples and IoT readings could be added but never deleted: new spc-sample-delete {product, index} and iot-reading-delete {machineId, index} verbs (the IoT index addresses the same last-60 window iot-machine-state renders), with sample/reading lists and two-step deletes in QualitySPC and ShopFloorSuite. (2) Cpk at zero spread rendered 0.00 in red beside a note claiming it reads 1.00 by construction: Cpk is now null at zero spread and the cell renders '— / needs spread across samples'; the QualitySPC guard no longer treats null Cpk as 'no samples'.

title: Work orders list: no search/filter/detail view; machines and lots have no edit
fix_note: WorkOrderBoard listed orders with no search and no way to inspect or correct a record. It now has text search (number/product/machine/assignee/status/priority) with match counts and a no-match note, a per-order detail expansion showing all fields, machine edit via the OEE register form's upsert prefill, and a new owner-scoped lot-update verb with a TraceabilityTab edit mode (lot number fixed while editing, self-parent guarded).

title: Workbench heuristics weak: valid syllogism gets 'No clear claims found' / '0 premises extracted'; HLR traces 37% confidence; HLR 'invalid_mode' on long input
repro_steps: Workbench with 'All mammals are warm-blooded. Whales are mammals. Therefore whales are warm-blooded.'
expected: Premises/conclusion detected
actual: 0 premises, no claims
fix_note: premiseExtractCore classified a sentence as a premise only when it contained a connective indicator word, so the canonical syllogism ('All mammals are warm-blooded. Whales are mammals. Therefore whales are warm-blooded.') extracted 0 premises and the Workbench reported 'No clear claims found'. Indicator matching is now word-boundary (the substring test also matched 'as'/'for' inside unrelated words) and a structural rule applies: in a text that has a conclusion, non-conclusion sentences are premises; prose with no conclusion keeps statement roles. New pin server/tests/reasoning-premise-extract.test.js 3/3; reasoning macros + parity green. Named, not claimed: the title's HLR legs (37% trace confidence, invalid_mode on long input) carry no repro and were not reproduced — they belong to the HLR engine and are the desk's to re-walk.

title: Science deletes have no undo; mobile tab strip clipped with no scroll cue; subview buttons ~30px; a11y unnamed/unlabeled fields
fix_note: Local legs fixed: ArtifactsPanel artifact deletes were one-click with no confirm and no undo — now a two-step named confirm ('Delete <title>? Confirm' / Keep). ExperimentActionPanel's placeholder-only row inputs gained aria-labels (instrument name/serial, calibration dates, safety description, sample ID) and its row-remove icon buttons gained a 40px hit area. Named residuals: the clipped frame tab strip is the founder-ruled NorthStarFrame shape (shell slice), and a true undo rides the founder DTU archive/delete verb family (desk slice).

title: No way for a user to create a prediction market; wagering untestable
repro_steps: Browse all worlds
expected: Open markets or create flow
actual: No open market anywhere; no create UI
fix_note: Premise half-stale: prediction-market creation exists — in the Markets lens (PredictionMarkets create flow) — but Spectate, where the walker looked for it, never said so. Spectate's empty state and populated worlds view now signpost 'Create a prediction market in the Markets lens'. No wagering surface was built inside Spectate; Money OFF untouched.
